title: Medical-Synthetic-Data (LLM-CTGAN)
summary: A research project that augments rare-disease clinical records from MIMIC-IV by conditioning a modified Conditional Tabular GAN on LLM-derived embeddings of each patient's clinical context. The project vendors and rewrites CTGAN's own source tree (including its rdt-based data transformer) to add this embedding pathway, and separately calls sdmetrics' KSComplement to check fidelity, making the CTGAN component the load-bearing foundation it extends.
evidence: ctgan/data_transformer.py:8 'from rdt.transformers import ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder' inside vendored, modified ctgan/ tree; sdmetrics.single_column.KSComplement used in EDA notebooks
needs: confirm whether llm_ctgan.py's modifications are a fork of the full ctgan package or only partial reuse of its transformer/synthesizer classes
